description: This source file contains functions for processing and parsing WebConfig data structures related to Telco Voice Manager, including handling msgpack objects, and converting them into internal data structures for configuration management.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_LineTable
methods.description: Parses a msgpack map into a WebConfig_LineTable_t structure, extracting boolean and string fields related to line configuration.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_VoiceServiceParams
methods.description: Parses a msgpack map into a WebConfig_VoiceServiceTable_t structure, handling various network and profile parameters, including nested line tables.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_SipNetworkTable
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a WebConfig_SipNwTable_t structure, extracting SIP network configuration parameters.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_SipClientTable
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a WebConfig_SipClientTable_t structure, extracting SIP client configuration parameters.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_ProfileTable
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a WebConfig_VoIPTable_t structure, handling profile-specific parameters.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_POTSFxsTable
methods.description: Converts a msgpack map into a WebConfig_POTSFxsTable_t structure, handling FXS (Foreign Exchange Station) parameters.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceMgr_WebConfig_Process_TelcoVoipParams
methods.description: Main function to process the top-level msgpack object into the overall Telco VoIP WebConfig structure, including version check and nested service tables.
